content.title: Kentucky vs Santa Clara schedule, TV channel for March Madness game
content.text: Updated March 17, 2026, 3:40 p.m. MTKentucky and Santa Clara play in a March Madness NCAA Tournament men's college basketball game on Friday, March 20.Here's what to know about the time, TV channel, streaming information and announcers for the Midwest Region March Madness first-round game.Kentucky is the No. 7 seed in the region.Santa Clara is the No. 10 seed.The winner of this game
